answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in glacier, expire in juniper, and crystal lists each expiry. An adversary running 117 aliases therefore needs 66 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3694 identities would post 4014 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
